items.title: Ipswich sign Maeda from Celtic
items.summary: Daizen Maeda has completed his move to Ipswich Town from Celtic in a £10m deal.

items.title: 'People do not just fail to turn up' - Woking hit back at Defoe after exit
items.summary: Woking's director of football Jody Brown claims Jermain Defoe didn't turn up for a meeting and training before he left his role as head coach after just four months in charge.

items.title: LeBron stuns basketball with move to 76ers!
items.summary: LeBron James has stunned the basketball world once again by announcing he's signed for the Philadelphia 76ers, a franchise that hasn't won an NBA title in 43 years.

items.title: Growing concerns before Defoe exit - Woking director
items.summary: Woking director of football Jody Brown says there were "growing concerns" across the club before the National League side parted ways with former England striker Jermain Defoe as manager.

items.title: Inter Milan interested in signing Tottenham captain Romero
items.summary: Inter Milan are interested in signing Tottenham captain Cristian Romero, according to Sky in Italy.

items.title: Unhappy Tottenham players should leave - De Zerbi
items.summary: Tottenham Hotspur manager Roberto de Zerbi says players who are not "proud and happy to stay" at the club should leave.

items.title: Could Mount be final piece in Man Utd midfield jigsaw?
items.summary: Mason Mount has been outstanding alongside new arrival Andrey Santos for Manchester United in their first two pre-season games.

items.title: Chelsea in talks for Villa set-piece guru MacPhee
items.summary: Chelsea are looking to sign highly regarded set-piece coach Austin MacPhee from Aston Villa but they face competition from Premier League and Saudi Pro League clubs.
